教学重点，不是肌电（EMG）；颜色只区分肌群，不表示用力大小。: Teaching focus, not EMG data; colors distinguish muscle groups and do not indicate force or effort.
前、中、后束协同控制承重肩，接住每一次换手。: The anterior, middle, and posterior heads work together to control the loaded shoulder through every hand transfer.
位于深层，帮助稳定肱骨头，支撑方向不断变化时护住肩关节。: Deep muscles that help stabilize the humeral head and protect the shoulder as the support direction changes.
仅用冈下肌位置示意（斜线＝深层）；冈上肌、小圆肌、肩胛下肌未单独绘制。: Only the infraspinatus is shown as a positional guide (hatching = deep layer); the supraspinatus, teres minor, and subscapularis are not drawn separately.
伸肘锁住支撑臂，手臂保持伸直受控。: Extend the elbow to lock the supporting arm while keeping it straight and controlled.
掌根撑地时控制手腕与手指，平稳落手、卸载。: Control the wrist and fingers when the heel of the palm is on the floor; place and unload the hand smoothly.
屈肌群与伸肌群各合为一块面板；手部小肌群未绘制。: The flexor and extensor groups are each combined into one panel; the small muscles of the hand are not drawn.
让肩胛贴着胸廓前伸，主动把地面推远。: Protract the shoulder blade along the rib cage and actively push the floor away.
只画出胸廓侧面可见的部分；被肩胛骨覆盖的部分未绘制。: Only the visible part along the side of the rib cage is drawn; the part covered by the shoulder blade is omitted.
协同调整肩胛位置，维持肩带与地面之间的支撑空间。: Work together to adjust shoulder-blade position and maintain space for support between the shoulder girdle and the floor.
菱形肌在斜方肌深层，这里与斜方肌中下部合为一块面板。: The rhomboids lie deep to the trapezius; here they are combined with the middle and lower trapezius in one panel.
前撑转侧撑时，配合控制上臂相对胸廓的方向。: During the turn from front support to side support, help control the upper arm's direction relative to the rib cage.
连接上臂与躯干，参与肩部下压与身体随支撑转移。: Connect the upper arm to the trunk and help depress the shoulder as support shifts.
卷腹折叠躯干，与深层腹横肌一起稳住骨盆，给抬腿留出空间。: Flex and tuck the trunk; together with the deep transverse abdominis, stabilize the pelvis and make room to lift the legs.
面板为腹直肌；腹横肌位于深层，没有单独面板。: The panel shows rectus abdominis; the transverse abdominis is deep and has no separate panel.
参与躯干旋转与侧向控制，让肩与骨盆随摆腿转动。: Help control trunk rotation and side bending so the shoulders and pelvis can turn with the leg swing.
面板为腹外斜肌；腹内斜肌在其深层，未单独绘制。: The panel shows the external oblique; the internal oblique lies deep to it and is not drawn separately.
控制脊柱伸展与躯干位置，后撑时帮助保持髋高。: Control spinal extension and trunk position; help keep the hips lifted in back support.
腰方肌（腰部深层）暂无面板，未显示。: Quadratus lumborum (deep in the waist) has no panel and is not shown.
位于骨盆深处，主动屈髋，把长腿从身体前方抬过去。: Deep in the pelvis; actively flex the hip to lift the straight leg past the front of the body.
髂腰肌在深层（斜线），与阔筋膜张肌合为一块面板示意；股直肌见股四头肌。: The iliopsoas is deep (hatched) and shown together with tensor fasciae latae in one panel; see quadriceps for rectus femoris.
髋伸展与后方扫腿（深层髋旋转肌配合调整腿的方向）。: Hip extension and the backward leg sweep (deep hip rotators help adjust the leg's direction).
深层髋外旋肌群没有单独面板。: The deep hip external rotators do not have a separate panel.
主动开腿并控制骨盆，离地后双腿不合拢。: Actively abduct the legs and control the pelvis; keep the legs apart after they leave the floor.
臀小肌在臀中肌深层，未单独绘制。: Gluteus minimus lies deep to gluteus medius and is not shown separately.
控制腿向中线回收与开度变化，衔接下一段扫腿。: Control the leg's return toward the midline and changes in leg separation, linking into the next sweep.
长收肌、短收肌、大收肌、股薄肌合为一块面板。: Adductor longus, adductor brevis, adductor magnus, and gracilis are combined in one panel.
保持膝部伸直，让长腿连续绕行。: Keep the knee extended so the straight leg can continue circling.
股中间肌位于深层，未单独绘制。: Vastus intermedius is deep and is not shown separately.
后侧长腿线条，参与髋伸与膝部控制。: The muscles along the back of the thigh help extend the hip and control the knee.
双手推地撑住身体，屈髋把开立的长腿抬过身体前方；腹部卷紧，臀中肌保持开腿。: Push through both hands to hold the body up. Flex the hips to lift the wide, straight legs across the front of the body; brace the abdomen and keep the legs apart with the gluteus medius.
双臂伸直锁肘，把身体撑离地面。: Straighten and lock both elbows to lift the body off the floor.
肩前倾在手的上方，控制承重肩。: Lean the shoulders forward over the hands and control the loaded shoulder.
主动屈髋，把长腿抬过身体前方。: Actively flex the hips to lift the straight legs across the front of the body.
卷腹折叠躯干，给抬腿留出空间。: Flex and tuck the trunk to make room for the leg lift.
双腿保持大开度，过前方时不合拢。: Keep the legs widely separated as they pass in front.
单手接重: Catch the weight with one hand
重量从双手移到单手：支撑侧三角肌、肱三头肌和前锯肌一起接住体重，腕屈肌稳住掌根；: Shift the load from both hands to one: the supporting-side deltoid, triceps, and serratus anterior catch the body weight together; the wrist flexors stabilize the heel of the palm; the obliques turn the pelvis to the side.
整个上身的重量转到这一侧肩上。: Transfer the weight of the entire upper body onto this shoulder.
支撑臂伸肘锁住，不让手肘弯塌。: Extend and lock the supporting arm so the elbow does not buckle.
肩胛贴住胸廓前伸，主动把地面推远。: Protract the shoulder blade along the rib cage and actively push the floor away.
掌根刚接住体重，腕屈肌控制手腕不塌。: As the heel of the palm catches the weight, the wrist flexors keep the wrist from collapsing.
转动躯干，让骨盆跟着摆腿转向侧面。: Rotate the trunk so the pelvis turns to the side with the leg swing.
单手撑起全身、身体侧立：支撑肩最吃力，肩袖护住肩关节；腹斜肌把髋撑高，臀中肌打开: Lift the whole body on one hand with the body turned sideways: the supporting shoulder works hardest, the rotator cuff protects the joint, the obliques lift the hips, and the gluteus medius opens the legs into a high V.
单臂承担全身重量，肩部负荷最大的时刻。: One arm supports the full body weight; this is the moment of greatest shoulder load.
手臂保持笔直，身体才能侧立撑高。: Keep the arm straight to hold the body up on its side.
手臂举过头承重，肩袖把肱骨头稳在关节里。: Bear weight with the arm overhead; the rotator cuff keeps the humeral head centered in the joint.
侧面核心把骨盆撑高，身体不往下塌。: The side core lifts the pelvis so the body does not sag.
臀中肌外展双腿，撑开高 V 字。: The gluteus medius abducts the legs to hold the high V.
身体转向正面，双腿像剪刀一样换位过前：屈髋肌和腹直肌把腿带到前方，内收肌控制两腿: Turn the body to face forward and switch the legs past each other like scissors: the hip flexors and rectus abdominis bring the legs forward, the adductors control their crossing, and the free hand prepares to return to support.
仍是单手支撑，伸肘把身体顶住。: Continue supporting the body on one hand and extend the elbow to hold it up.
身体转向正面，承重肩随之转动控制。: Turn the body to face forward and control the turn through the loaded shoulder.
屈髋把扫行的腿带到身体前方。: Flex the hip to bring the sweeping leg in front of the body.
收腹折叠，骨盆抬住，给腿让出通道。: Brace and tuck the abdomen, lifting the pelvis to make room for the leg.
两腿剪刀式交错，内收肌控制开合。: Cross the legs like scissors; the adductors control their opening and closing.
开腿扫后方: Open the legs and sweep them behind
双手在身后撑地、胸口朝上：肱三头肌、三角肌和胸大肌像做臂屈伸一样顶住身体；双腿保: Support yourself on both hands behind the body with the chest facing up: the triceps, deltoids, and pectoralis major press the body up as in a dip; keep the legs wide and prepare to sweep them behind.
双手在身后推地，伸肘把身体顶起。: Press through both hands behind you and extend the elbows to lift the body.
肩在后伸位承重，前束最吃力。: Bear weight with the shoulder extended; the anterior deltoid works hardest.
胸大肌协助肩部在后伸位推地。: The pectoralis major helps press through the shoulder in its extended position.
双腿抬高大开度，准备向后扫。: Lift the legs wide and prepare to sweep them behind.
换手接重: Catch the weight with the other hand
换到另一只手单撑：支撑侧肩臂和前锯肌重新接住体重，腕屈肌稳住掌根；臀大肌带长腿从: Switch to a one-hand support on the other side: the supporting shoulder and arm, together with the serratus anterior, catch the body weight again; the wrist flexors stabilize the heel of the palm; the gluteus maximus drives the straight leg from front to back.
体重换到这一侧肩上，重新接住。: Shift the body weight onto this shoulder and catch it again.
新的支撑臂伸肘锁住。: Lock the new supporting arm straight.
肩胛前伸推地，肩不往下沉。: Protract the shoulder blade and push the floor away without letting the shoulder sink.
掌根刚接重，腕屈肌控制手腕。: As the heel of the palm catches the weight, the wrist flexors control the wrist.
伸髋发力，把长腿从前方扫向后方。: Extend the hip to sweep the straight leg from front to back.
另一侧单手侧撑：支撑肩与肩袖承担全身重量；腹斜肌撑高骨盆，臀中肌保持高 V 开腿: Side support on the other hand: the supporting shoulder and rotator cuff bear the full body weight; the obliques lift the pelvis and the gluteus medius holds the high V.
身体转回朝下，双腿扫过后方：臀大肌伸髋带腿，竖脊肌保持髋部高度，腹斜肌把身体旋回: Turn back to face down and sweep the legs behind: the gluteus maximus extends the hip and drives the leg, the erector spinae holds hip height, and the obliques rotate the body back; the free hand prepares to land and begin the next circle.
单手支撑中身体旋回，承重肩随之控制。: Rotate the body back while supporting yourself on one hand; control the turn through the loaded shoulder.
伸肘撑住，直到另一只手落地。: Keep the elbow straight until the other hand lands.
伸髋把长腿扫过身体后方。: Extend the hip to sweep the straight leg behind the body.
背部伸展肌群保持髋部高度，不塌腰。: The back extensors keep the hips lifted without arching the lower back.
躯干旋回，把身体接回后侧支撑。: Rotate the trunk back into rear support.
教学建议，非医疗处方；面向初中级 breaker 的保守剂量。: Teaching guidance, not a medical prescription; conservative doses for beginner-to-intermediate breakers.
支撑手在肩正下方，推地让肩远离耳朵: Place the supporting hand directly under the shoulder; push the floor away and keep the shoulder away from the ear.
髋抬到与肩同高，身体侧面成一条直线: Lift the hips to shoulder height and keep the side of the body in a straight line.
肩往耳朵方向塌、髋下沉，重量压进肩关节。: The shoulder collapses toward the ear and the hips sag, loading the shoulder joint.
与第一侧支撑同一姿态：单臂承担全身重量，练三角肌接住侧撑。: Use the same position as first-side support: one arm bears the full body weight, training the deltoid to catch the side support.
先做 2–3 分钟手腕热身；腕部刺痛或麻木立即停止。: Warm up the wrists for 2–3 minutes first; stop immediately if you feel sharp pain or numbness in the wrist.
哑铃半程土耳其起立（至高桥）: Dumbbell half Turkish get-up (to high bridge)
轻哑铃或壶铃 · 瑜伽垫: Light dumbbell or kettlebell · yoga mat
负重手臂始终垂直指天，眼睛看着哑铃: Keep the loaded arm vertical, pointing toward the ceiling, and watch the dumbbell.
撑地手推地抬髋，像侧撑一样把身体顶起: Push the floor away with the free hand and lift the hips, raising the body as in a side plank.
负重臂向头后或身体前方倒，肩失去锁定。: The loaded arm falls behind the head or forward, and the shoulder loses its stable position.
在身体转向不断变化时稳住双肩，正是换手时三角肌要做的事。: Keep both shoulders steady as the body turns in changing directions, as the deltoid must during a hand transfer.
从很轻的重量开始，每一步做稳再进入下一步。示范做到高桥后原路返回，不包含站起。肩: Start with a very light weight and move to the next step only after each step feels controlled. The demonstration ends at the high bridge and returns along the same path; it does not include standing up. If the front of the shoulder pinches, shorten the hold or use an easier version; do not push through it.
斜向前上方推到手臂伸直，最后肩胛向前送: Press diagonally forward and up until the arm is straight, finishing by reaching the shoulder blade forward.
收紧臀部和腹部，躯干不后仰: Tighten the glutes and abdomen; do not lean the trunk backward.
推起时腰往后仰借力，肋骨外翻。: Leaning the lower back backward to help press, with the ribs flaring out.
斜线推举对肩更友好，强化三角肌在手臂高于肩时的力量，对应支撑臂举过头承重。: The diagonal press is often easier on the shoulder and builds deltoid strength with the arm above shoulder height, like supporting yourself with the arm overhead.
肩前侧夹痛时缩短时长或改简单版本，不要硬撑。: If the front of the shoulder pinches, shorten the hold or use an easier version; do not push through it.
俯撑交替触肩: Alternating shoulder taps from a high plank
双脚略分开，触肩时骨盆不左右晃: Set the feet slightly apart and keep the pelvis from swaying side to side as you tap.
承重手推地、肘锁直，肩不往下塌: Push through the supporting hand, lock the elbow, and keep the shoulder from sinking.
触得太快，身体跟着手左右摇晃。: Tapping too quickly and letting the body rock from side to side.
单手瞬间接住体重时，肩袖要把肱骨头稳在关节里，模拟每一次换手。: When one hand briefly catches the body weight, the rotator cuff keeps the humeral head stable in the joint, as in each hand transfer.
弹力带肘贴体侧外旋: Resistance-band external rotation with elbow at side
轻阻力弹力带（毛巾夹在腋下）: Light resistance band (hold a towel under the armpit)
肘贴住身体、弯 90°，只让前臂向外打开: Keep the elbow against the body, bent to 90°; move only the forearm outward.
慢放 3 秒，肩不耸起: Return slowly over 3 seconds without shrugging the shoulder.
用转身代替转肩，或手肘离开身体。: Turning the body instead of the shoulder, or letting the elbow move away from the body.
直接加强深层外旋肌，让肩在支撑方向变化时更稳、更耐用。: Directly strengthens the deep external rotators to help the shoulder stay stable and tolerate changes in support direction.
上臂与肩同高、肘成 90°，前臂由前向上转到竖直: Raise the upper arm to shoulder height with the elbow at 90°; rotate the forearm from forward to vertical.
肩胛下沉后收，躯干不动: Set the shoulder blade down and back; keep the trunk still.
重量太重，用耸肩或后仰把绳子拉上去。: Using too much weight and pulling the cable up by shrugging or leaning back.
练手臂举起位置的肩袖控制，对应支撑臂在高位承重时的肩部稳定。: Trains rotator-cuff control with the arm raised, like shoulder stability when the supporting arm bears weight overhead.
选很轻的重量，出现肩前部疼痛立即停止。: Use a very light weight; stop immediately if pain appears at the front of the shoulder.
双手与肩同宽或略窄，肘贴身体向后弯: Place the hands shoulder-width or slightly narrower; bend the elbows back close to the body.
顶端肘完全伸直并停 1 秒，再把地面推远: At the top, fully straighten the elbows and pause for 1 second, then push the floor away.
肘向外翻，顶端没伸直就开始下一次。: Letting the elbows flare out or starting the next rep before straightening them at the top.
练出顶端锁肘的力量，支撑臂才能伸直撑住、不弯不软。: Builds strength to lock the elbows at the top so the supporting arm can stay straight and firm.
手臂伸直锁肘，肩往下压、远离耳朵: Lock the elbows straight and press the shoulders down, away from the ears.
屈膝收腿把身体撑离地面，可脚尖轻点地辅助: Tuck the knees and lift the body off the floor; the toes may lightly touch down for assistance.
肘微弯、耸肩，身体挂在肩关节上。: Keeping the elbows slightly bent, shrugging, or hanging from the shoulder joints.
全身重量压在伸直的手臂上，正是托马斯支撑臂需要的锁肘承重。: The straight arms bear the full body weight, matching the locked-elbow support needed in a flare.
下放到上臂约与地面平行即可，不要过深: Lower only until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor; do not go too deep.
顶端肘锁直、肩下压，停 1 秒: At the top, lock the elbows, press the shoulders down, and pause for 1 second.
下得太深、肩前倾塌陷，或用摆腿借力。: Lowering too far, letting the shoulders roll forward and collapse, or swinging the legs for momentum.
在完整幅度里加强伸肘力量，支撑和换手时手臂更不容易弯。: Builds elbow-extension strength through a full range so the arms are less likely to bend during support and hand transfers.
肩部不适者先做顶端支撑停留；下放深度控制在不痛的范围。: If the shoulder is uncomfortable, start with a top support hold; keep the lowering range pain-free.
跪姿多方向腕部摇摆: Kneeling wrist rocks in multiple directions
手指朝前、朝侧、朝后、掌背着地依次摇: Rock with the fingers pointing forward, sideways, and backward, then with the backs of the hands on the floor.
前后移动身体重心，力度由轻到重: Shift the body weight forward and back, starting lightly and increasing gradually.
一上来就压全重，或只做手指朝前一个方向。: Loading full weight immediately, or only rocking with the fingers pointing forward.
托马斯中掌根要从各个角度接地，这是让腕屈伸肌和腕关节适应负荷的基础。: In a flare, the heel of the palm meets the floor from many angles; this helps the wrist flexors, extensors, and wrist joint adapt to load.
前臂平放在大腿上，只动手腕: Rest the forearm flat on the thigh and move only the wrist.
上 1 秒、下 3 秒，全幅度慢放: Lift for 1 second and lower for 3 seconds through the full range.
甩动借力，或用前臂抬起代替手腕屈伸。: Swinging the weight or moving the forearm instead of the wrist.
腕屈肌稳住掌根、腕伸肌控制落手卸力，两侧都练才能平稳换手。: The wrist flexors stabilize the heel of the palm and the extensors control hand placement and unloading; training both helps make hand transfers smooth.
壶铃底朝上，前臂竖直、手腕中立: Hold the kettlebell upside down, forearm vertical and wrist neutral.
握紧手柄，肘在肩前下方，慢步走: Grip the handle firmly, keep the elbow just in front of and below the shoulder, and walk slowly.
手腕后折、握力松，壶铃倒下。: Letting the wrist bend back or the grip loosen, causing the kettlebell to fall.
倒握需要手指与手腕持续微调，练出支撑手掌根的控制力。: The upside-down hold requires constant small adjustments from the fingers and wrist, training control through the heel of the supporting hand.
重量宜轻；手腕要保持中立，不要后折。: Use a light weight; keep the wrist neutral and do not bend it back.
俯撑肩胛前伸: Scapular protraction in a high plank
手臂始终伸直，只让胸口下沉再推高: Keep the arms straight; let only the chest lower, then push it up.
顶端把背部推圆，肩胛向前包住胸廓: At the top, round the upper back and wrap the shoulder blades around the rib cage.
弯肘变成俯卧撑，或塌腰代替肩胛动作。: Bending the elbows into a push-up or arching the lower back instead of moving the shoulder blades.
直接练肩胛前伸——把地面推远，是托马斯支撑的核心动作。: Directly trains scapular protraction—the action of pushing the floor away that underpins flare support.
前臂贴住泡沫轴，往前推墙并向上滚: Keep the forearms on the foam roller, push it into the wall, and roll upward.
最高处手臂略离开泡沫轴，停 2 秒: At the highest point, let the arms lift slightly off the roller and pause for 2 seconds.
耸肩向上滑，或腰向前挺出。: Shrugging as you slide up or pushing the lower back forward.
练手臂举过头时前锯肌上旋肩胛，支撑臂高位承重更稳。: Trains the serratus anterior to rotate the shoulder blade upward when the arms are overhead, improving stability in high support.
吊环离地 10–20 厘米，环贴身体两侧: Set the rings 10–20 cm above the floor, close to the sides of the body.
推起后再把背推圆一点，稳住环不外散: After pushing up, round the upper back a little more and keep the rings from drifting outward.
环向两侧散开，肩前倾塌陷。: Letting the rings drift apart and the shoulders roll forward and collapse.
不稳定的支撑面迫使前锯肌持续发力，最接近地面上不断变化的支撑。: The unstable support surface makes the serratus anterior work continuously, closely matching the changing support on the floor.
额头轻贴地，先把肩胛下沉后收再抬手: Rest the forehead lightly on the floor; first set the shoulder blades down and back, then lift the hands.
拇指朝上，顶端停 2 秒: Turn the thumbs up and pause for 2 seconds at the top.
抬头、耸肩，用腰把上身抬高。: Lifting the head, shrugging, or raising the torso with the lower back.
加强斜方肌中下部与菱形肌，在支撑中把肩胛摆在正确位置。: Strengthens the middle and lower trapezius and rhomboids to help position the shoulder blades during support.
手臂始终伸直，只靠肩胛下沉把身体抬起几厘米: Keep the arms straight and lift the body a few centimeters by drawing the shoulder blades down.
顶端停 1 秒，再慢慢回到悬垂: Pause for 1 second at the top, then slowly return to a hang.
弯肘拉起，变成小幅引体向上。: Bending the elbows and turning it into a small pull-up.
练肩胛下压与稳定，这是支撑时“推地、肩远离耳朵”的同一组肌肉。: Trains scapular depression and stability—the same muscles used to push the floor away and keep the shoulders away from the ears during support.
悬垂前先确认单杠安装牢固；肩前侧夹痛时缩短时长或改简单版本，不要硬撑。: Before hanging, check that the bar is firmly installed. If the front of the shoulder pinches, shorten the hold or use an easier version; do not push through it.
手臂伸直，环贴身体两侧，掌心微微外旋: Keep the arms straight, rings close to the sides of the body, and palms slightly turned out.
肩胛下压，身体保持中空、不晃: Draw the shoulder blades down and keep the body hollow and steady.
环向外飘、耸肩，手臂弯曲。: Let the rings drift outward, shrug, or bend the arms.
最难的直臂支撑练习之一，强迫肩胛肌群持续调整，维持肩带与支撑点之间的空间。: One of the hardest straight-arm support drills; it makes the scapular muscles keep adjusting to maintain space between the shoulder girdle and the support point.
先在双杠上练稳支撑，再上吊环；肩前侧夹痛时缩短时长或改简单版本，不要硬撑。: First build a steady support on parallel bars, then move to rings. If the front of the shoulder pinches, shorten the hold or use an easier version; do not push through it.
推起后整体转向侧面，支撑手不动: After pushing up, rotate the whole body to the side without moving the supporting hand.
转动时胸和骨盆一起走，不先扭腰: Turn the chest and pelvis together; do not twist the lower back first.
转身太快，支撑肩塌下去。: Turning too quickly and letting the supporting shoulder collapse.
就是前撑转侧撑的过程：胸大肌配合控制上臂与胸廓的方向。: This is the movement from front support to side support: the pectoralis major helps control the upper arm's direction relative to the rib cage.
胸口下沉到双手之间，肘约 45° 夹向身体: Lower the chest between the hands with the elbows about 45° from the body.
推起后手臂锁直，肩胛前伸: Push up, lock the arms, and protract the shoulder blades.
下沉过深导致肩前顶，或塌腰。: Lowering too far so the front of the shoulder jams, or letting the lower back sag.
握杆让手腕中立，更大幅度强化胸大肌，支撑转换更有力。: Using bars keeps the wrists neutral and trains the pectoralis major through a greater range, making support transitions stronger.
弓步站稳，单臂向前推到伸直: Stand in a stable split stance and press one arm forward until straight.
推的时候躯干不跟着转，核心抗旋转: Do not rotate the trunk as you press; brace against rotation.
用转身代替推，或耸肩。: Turning the body instead of pressing, or shrugging the shoulder.
单侧推需要胸大肌和核心一起控制方向，对应单手支撑时手臂与胸廓的关系。: A one-sided press makes the pectoralis major and core work together to control direction, as the arm and rib cage must during one-hand support.
坐姿撑地抬臀: Seated hip lift with hands on floor
3 组 × 8 次（顶端停 2 秒）: 3 sets × 8 reps (2-second pause at the top)
长坐，双手撑在髋两侧，手臂伸直: Sit with legs extended, hands on the floor beside the hips, and arms straight.
用肩往下压把臀部抬离地面，不靠弯肘: Press the shoulders down to lift the hips; do not bend the elbows.
弯肘撑起或耸肩，变成三头肌练习。: Bending the elbows to push up or shrugging, turning it into a triceps exercise.
背阔肌下压肩带把身体撑起，正是后撑和换手时躯干跟着支撑转移的感觉。: The latissimus dorsi depresses the shoulder girdle to lift the body, like the feeling of the trunk following the support shift in back support and hand transfers.
手臂伸直，从额头高度下拉到大腿旁: Keep the arms straight and pull from forehead height down to beside the thighs.
下拉时肩胛下沉，肋骨不外翻: Draw the shoulder blades down as you pull; keep the ribs from flaring.
弯肘、身体前后摆动借力。: Bending the elbows or swinging the body back and forth for momentum.
直臂下压正是背阔肌在托马斯中的工作方式：连接上臂与躯干。: The straight-arm pulldown matches how the latissimus dorsi works in a flare: connecting the upper arm to the trunk.
手臂锁直，让肩慢慢升向耳朵: Lock the arms straight and slowly let the shoulders rise toward the ears.
再用力下压把身体顶高，顶端停 1 秒: Then press the shoulders down firmly to lift the body; pause for 1 second at the top.
弯肘上下，变成臂屈伸。: Bending the elbows as you move up and down, turning it into dips.
全身重量下练肩下压，直接迁移到支撑时身体随手移动的控制。: Train shoulder depression under full body weight; this directly carries over to controlling the body as the hands move during support.
下背压实地面，肩胛离地: Press the lower back into the floor and lift the shoulder blades.
手和腿离地越低越难，以腰不离地为准: The lower the hands and legs, the harder it is; keep the lower back on the floor.
腰拱起离开地面，憋气。: Arching the lower back off the floor or holding the breath.
练腹直肌与腹横肌稳住骨盆的“中空”体态，摆腿时躯干不散。: Train the rectus and transverse abdominis to stabilize the pelvis in a hollow position so the trunk stays connected as the legs swing.
全程保持腰椎中立，腰部发紧或疼痛时减小幅度。: Keep the lumbar spine neutral throughout; reduce the range if the lower back tightens or hurts.
手臂锁直、肩下压，把膝盖抬到胸前: Lock the arms, press the shoulders down, and lift the knees toward the chest.
能力够了再一条腿伸直，逐步到 L 撑: When ready, straighten one leg at a time, gradually working toward an L-sit.
弓背耸肩，膝盖下垂碰地。: Rounding the back and shrugging, or letting the knees drop and touch the floor.
同时做“直臂支撑 + 卷腹折叠”，就是后撑抬长腿过前方的组合。: Combines straight-arm support with a trunk tuck, like lifting straight legs across the front from back support.
双杠直臂支撑举腿: Straight-arm leg raise on parallel bars
手臂锁直撑起，骨盆后倾卷腹抬腿: Support yourself on straight arms, tilt the pelvis back, and curl the legs up.
慢慢放下，腿不摆动: Lower slowly without swinging the legs.
甩腿借惯性，肩往耳朵塌。: Kicking the legs for momentum or letting the shoulders collapse toward the ears.
在支撑中做折叠，给抬腿留空间，正对应腹直肌在托马斯中的作用。: Practice folding the trunk while supported to make room for the leg lift, matching the rectus abdominis' role in a flare.
从四足悬膝位起，单手撑地，腿从身体下方穿过去: Start in a bear position with knees hovering; support yourself on one hand and thread the leg under the body.
转体时支撑手推地，髋不要落地: As you rotate, push the floor away with the supporting hand and keep the hips off the floor.
臀部坐到地上，支撑肩塌。: Sit the hips on the floor or let the supporting shoulder collapse.
在单手支撑下旋转躯干、腿从身下穿过，是托马斯转体的雏形。: Rotating on one-hand support while threading a leg under the body is a starting point for the flare turn.
侧对固定点，双手握带在胸前向前推直: Stand sideways to the anchor, hold the band at the chest, and press both hands straight forward.
推直后停 2 秒，身体不被拉转: Pause for 2 seconds with the arms straight; do not let the body turn toward the band.
跟着弹力带转身，或耸肩。: Turning with the band or shrugging the shoulders.
抗旋转是转体的另一半：腹斜肌要把肩与骨盆的转动控制住。: Controlling rotation is the other half of turning: the obliques control how the shoulders and pelvis rotate.
绳索器械 · 单柄或绳: Cable machine · single handle or rope
从高处斜向下拉到对侧髋外，手臂基本伸直: Pull diagonally down from a high position to the outside of the opposite hip, with the arms mostly straight.
肩与骨盆一起转，后脚跟随转动: Rotate the shoulder and pelvis together and let the back heel turn.
只用手臂拉，或腰椎过度扭转。: Pulling only with the arms or twisting the lower back too far.
练肩和骨盆协同旋转，对应随摆腿转身的控制。: Trains coordinated rotation of the shoulders and pelvis, as needed to turn with the leg swing.
反向平板（后撑抬髋）: Reverse plank (back support with hip lift)
双手在肩下方，手指朝脚或朝两侧: Place the hands under the shoulders, fingers pointing toward the feet or out to the sides.
推地抬髋到身体一条直线，夹紧臀部: Push through the floor and lift the hips until the body forms a straight line; squeeze the glutes.
髋下坠、头后仰，肩往前塌。: Hips sag, head drops back, or shoulders collapse forward.
后撑时竖脊肌帮助保持髋高，这个姿势就是后侧支撑的静态版。: The erector spinae help keep the hips lifted in back support; this is a static version of rear-side support.
先做 2–3 分钟手腕热身；腕部刺痛或麻木立即停止。手指可朝两侧减轻腕部压力。: Warm up the wrists for 2–3 minutes first; stop immediately if you feel sharp pain or numbness in the wrist. Fingers may point sideways to reduce wrist pressure.
瑞士球（健身球）· 墙边抵脚: Swiss ball · feet braced against a wall
髋压在球上，双脚抵住墙根: Place the hips on the ball and brace both feet against the base of the wall.
抬到身体一条直线即可，不过度后仰: Lift until the body forms a straight line; do not lean back too far.
甩起上身、抬过头造成腰椎过伸。: Jerking the torso up or extending it past a straight line, causing lumbar hyperextension.
练竖脊肌控制脊柱伸展，帮助后撑和侧撑时躯干不塌。: Trains the erector spinae to control spinal extension and keep the trunk from collapsing in back and side support.
垫子顶在髋骨下方，以髋为轴下放: Position the pad below the hip bones and lower by hinging at the hips.
起到身体一条直线、停 1 秒，不再往后仰: Rise until the body forms a straight line, pause for 1 second, and do not lean farther back.
腰椎过伸甩起，或圆背下放太快。: Swinging up with an overextended lower back or lowering too quickly with a rounded back.
用器械稳定地加强后链，后撑抬髋更有力、更持久。: Strengthens the posterior chain with stable equipment for stronger, longer hip lifts in back support.
长坐，双手撑在膝盖两侧，腿伸直: Sit with legs extended and hands on the floor beside the knees.
躯干前倾，主动把双腿抬离地面 2–5 厘米: Lean the trunk forward and actively lift both legs 2–5 cm off the floor.
身体后仰去抬腿，或膝盖弯曲。: Leaning backward to lift the legs or bending the knees.
练屈髋肌在缩短位主动发力，把长腿从身体前方抬过去。: Trains the hip flexors to contract actively in a shortened position and lift straight legs past the front of the body.
弹力带（套在脚上，另一端固定或踩住）: Resistance band (around the foot, anchored or held under the other foot)
3 组 × 每侧 10 次（顶端停 2 秒）: 3 sets × 10 reps per side (2-second pause at the top)
站直扶墙，膝盖抬过髋的高度: Stand upright with a hand on the wall for balance; lift the knee above hip height.
顶端停 2 秒，骨盆不后倾、不弯腰: Pause for 2 seconds at the top without tilting the pelvis back or arching the lower back.
后仰或耸肩，把膝抬到髋以下就停。: Leaning back or shrugging, or stopping before the knee reaches hip height.
在超过 90° 的屈髋范围加阻力，正是长腿抬过前方需要的力量。: Adds resistance beyond 90° of hip flexion, the range needed to lift a straight leg past the front of the body.
脚踝扣连低位绳索，膝伸直、脚尖勾起: Attach a low cable to the ankle strap; keep the knee straight and toes pulled up.
抬到能控制的最高点，慢放: Lift as high as you can control, then lower slowly.
用后仰或摆动把腿甩上去。: Swinging or leaning back to fling the leg upward.
长杠杆直腿屈髋，对应托马斯中伸直的长腿绕过身体前方。: Long-lever straight-leg hip flexion, matching the straight leg's sweep around the front of the body in the flare.
支撑脚跟发力推地，把髋抬平: Drive through the supporting heel to lift the hips level.
顶端夹臀停 2 秒，骨盆不歪: Squeeze the glutes and pause for 2 seconds at the top; keep the pelvis level.
用腰拱起代替伸髋，骨盆向一侧掉。: Arching the lower back instead of extending the hip, or letting one side of the pelvis drop.
练臀大肌伸髋，为后方扫腿和后撑抬髋打基础。: Trains gluteus maximus hip extension as a foundation for the backward leg sweep and hip lift in back support.
弹力带（套在双脚）· 瑜伽垫: Resistance band (around both feet) · yoga mat
四足跪姿，腿伸直向后上方抬: Start on hands and knees; extend one leg and lift it back and up.
腰不塌，只让髋发力: Keep the lower back from sagging; move from the hip.
抬太高导致腰椎过伸。: Overextending the lower back by lifting too high.
直腿向后扫，对应托马斯中长腿向后方绕过去的动作。: A straight-leg backward sweep, matching the long leg circling behind the body in a flare.
上身趴在垫上握紧把手，双腿伸直: Lie face down on the pad and grip the handles; keep both legs straight.
靠臀发力把腿抬到与躯干同高，慢放: Use the glutes to lift the legs to trunk height, then lower slowly.
甩腿借力，抬过躯干高度。: Swinging the legs for momentum or lifting them above trunk height.
直腿在身后做伸髋，是长腿后扫最接近的器械动作。: Hip extension with straight legs behind the body is the closest machine exercise to the backward leg sweep.
前臂侧撑，髋抬起成一条直线: Support yourself on one forearm, lift the hips, and keep the body in a straight line.
上方腿伸直抬起，脚尖朝前不外转: Keep the top leg straight as you lift it; point the toes forward without turning them out.
髋下沉，或上腿向前摆。: Letting the hips sag or swinging the top leg forward.
臀中肌在支撑下主动开腿，像侧撑时撑开高 V 字。: The gluteus medius actively abducts the leg under support, like opening into a high V in side support.
小弹力圈（套在脚踝）· 瑜伽垫: Mini band (around the ankles) · yoga mat
3 组 × 12 次（开到最大停 2 秒）: 3 sets × 12 reps (hold 2 seconds at the widest point)
仰卧，双腿伸直举起与地面垂直: Lie on your back with straight legs raised vertically.
对抗弹力带把腿分开成大 V 字，再慢慢合拢: Press against the band to open the legs into a wide V, then slowly bring them together.
屈膝、腰离地。: Bending the knees or lifting the lower back off the floor.
双腿离地时主动撑开 V 字，正是托马斯中开腿不合拢需要的力量。: Actively opening the V while both legs are off the floor builds the strength needed to keep the legs apart in a flare.
3 组 × 12–15 次（顶端停 1 秒）: 3 sets × 12–15 reps (1-second pause at the top)
坐稳靠背，膝外侧推开垫子: Sit back securely and press the pads outward with the outsides of the knees.
慢回 3 秒，不让重量砸回: Return over 3 seconds; do not let the weight crash back.
身体前后晃动借力，回程失控。: Rocking the body for momentum or losing control on the return.
稳定地给臀中肌加负荷，提升开腿的力量和耐力。: Adds stable resistance for the gluteus medius to improve leg-opening strength and endurance.
宽站距，蹲向一侧，另一腿伸直脚尖朝上: Take a wide stance and squat to one side, keeping the other leg straight with the toes pointing up.
脚跟踩实，胸口挺起: Keep the heel planted and lift the chest.
伸直腿的膝盖弯曲，或蹲的那侧脚跟离地。: Bending the straight leg's knee or letting the squatting-side heel lift.
在拉长位置训练内收肌的控制，对应开度变化中把腿收回中线。: Trains adductor control in a lengthened position, like drawing the leg back toward the midline as the leg separation changes.
膝关节不适时减小下蹲深度。: Reduce squat depth if the knee joint is uncomfortable.
上方腿膝内侧压在凳上，前臂撑地: Rest the inside of the top knee on the bench and support yourself on the forearm.
用内收肌把髋顶起，身体成一条直线: Use the adductors to lift the hips and form a straight line with the body.
髋下沉、身体前倾。: Letting the hips sag or leaning the body forward.
内收肌在支撑负荷下发力，强化腿向中线回收的控制。: Loads the adductors during support and strengthens control as the leg returns toward the midline.
从屈膝短力臂版本开始；腹股沟刺痛立即停止。: Start with the bent-knee, shorter-lever version; stop immediately if you feel sharp groin pain.
侧对器械，内侧腿扣绳索，腿伸直: Stand sideways to the machine, attach the cable to the inside leg, and keep the leg straight.
从外侧拉回并越过中线，慢放: Pull the leg inward from the outside and across the midline, then return slowly.
用上身侧倾带动腿。: Leaning the upper body sideways to move the leg.
从外开位置控制收回，对应衔接下一段扫腿时的开度变化。: Controls the return from an open position, matching the change in leg separation as the next sweep begins.
3 组 × 6 次（小幅度起）: 3 sets × 6 reps (start with a small range)
跪立，膝到肩一条直线，夹紧臀部: Kneel with the knees, hips, and shoulders aligned; squeeze the glutes.
向后倾到可控范围再回正，不在髋处折叠: Lean back only as far as you can control, then return upright without hinging at the hips.
屈髋后坐，或倒得太深回不来。: Sitting the hips back or leaning too far to recover.
在拉长位加强股四头肌（含股直肌），让膝在长腿绕行时保持伸直。: Strengthens the quadriceps (including rectus femoris) in a lengthened position so the knee stays straight as the long leg circles.
膝前不适时减小后倾幅度，可在膝下加垫。: If the front of the knee is uncomfortable, reduce the lean and add padding under the knees.
3 组 × 每侧 15 次（锁直停 2 秒）: 3 sets × 15 reps per side (lock straight and hold 2 seconds)
弹力带套在膝后，微屈膝开始: Place the band behind the knee and start with the knee slightly bent.
用力把膝锁直，大腿前侧绷紧: Fully straighten the knee with force and tighten the front of the thigh.
只是挺髋，膝并没有完全伸直。: Only pushing the hips forward without fully straightening the knee.
专练最后锁直膝盖的那一下，长腿才能保持伸直。: Practices the final knee lockout so the long leg can stay straight.
器械腿屈伸（顶端锁直）: Machine leg extension (lock out at top)
3 组 × 10–12 次（顶端停 2 秒）: 3 sets × 10–12 reps (2-second pause at the top)
膝关节对齐器械转轴: Align the knee joint with the machine's pivot.
踢到完全伸直、脚尖回勾，停 2 秒慢放: Kick until the knee is fully straight, pull the toes up, pause for 2 seconds, and lower slowly.
重量太重，用甩踢代替控制。: Using too much weight and replacing control with a swinging kick.
在完全伸直位加强股四头肌，让膝在快速绕腿中不弯。: Strengthens the quadriceps at full knee extension so the knee does not bend during fast leg circles.
重量从轻开始；膝前痛时缩小幅度。: Start with a light weight; reduce the range if the front of the knee hurts.
支撑腿膝微屈，以髋为轴向前折: Soften the supporting knee and hinge forward from the hip.
后腿与躯干成一条直线，骨盆端平: Keep the back leg and trunk in one straight line and the pelvis level.
圆背、骨盆向外翻开。: Rounding the back or turning the pelvis outward.
练腘绳肌拉长下的控制，长腿后侧线条又稳又有力。: Trains control of the hamstrings while lengthened, keeping the back of the long leg stable and strong.
滑盘或毛巾（光滑地面）: Sliders or towel (on a smooth floor)
仰卧抬髋，脚跟踩在滑盘上: Lie on your back with hips lifted and heels on the sliders.
保持髋高，脚跟向臀部拉回再慢慢推出: Keep the hips high; draw the heels toward the glutes, then slowly slide them back out.
髋往下掉，动作变成蹭地。: Letting the hips drop so the movement turns into dragging on the floor.
同时练伸髋与屈膝控制，对应腘绳肌参与髋伸与膝部控制。: Trains hip extension and knee-flexion control together, matching the hamstrings' role at the hip and knee.
腘绳肌易抽筋，先从脚跟推出的离心部分练起。: If the hamstrings cramp easily, start with the eccentric phase by sliding the heels away.
GHD（臀腿训练器）或北欧挺器械: GHD (glute-ham developer) or Nordic curl machine
脚跟扣紧，膝到头一条直线: Lock the heels in place and keep the knees, hips, and head aligned.
尽量慢地向前下放，手推地辅助回起: Lower forward as slowly as possible and use the hands on the floor to help return.
屈髋撅臀，或一下子摔下去。: Hinging at the hips and sticking the buttocks out, or dropping suddenly.
离心加强腘绳肌，提升后侧长腿的力量与抗拉伤能力。: Builds hamstring strength eccentrically and improves the strength and strain resistance of the back of the long leg.
初学者只做小幅离心并用手接住；腘绳肌拉伤史者先咨询专业人士。: Beginners should use a small lowering range and catch themselves with their hands. Anyone with a history of hamstring injury should consult a qualified professional first.
课程为用户提供包中的第一版草稿，尚待 breaking 教练审核；周数仅为示意。: The course is an initial draft provided in the app and still needs review by a breaking coach; the number of weeks is illustrative. Users record their own progress; it does not indicate skill mastery, an AI score, or a medical assessment. All stages are available to browse.
每只手侧撑 10 秒: Side support on each hand · 10 sec
后撑换手到侧撑: Hand transfer from back support to side support
落手：掌先平、手臂竖直: Hand landing: palm flat first, arm vertical

肩袖位于肩关节周围，参与肱骨头的稳定和上臂旋转控制。全旋支撑方向不断改变，观察换: The rotator cuff surrounds the shoulder joint and helps stabilize the humeral head and control upper-arm rotation. As support direction changes through a full circle, observe the shoulder's position relative to the trunk during hand transfers; appearance alone does not show how deep muscles are working.
肱三头肌参与伸肘，与肩带和腕部一起控制支撑臂。观察前撑、后撑和换手接地时，可留意: The triceps help extend the elbow and control the supporting arm together with the shoulder girdle and wrist. During front support, back support, and hand placement, notice whether the elbow stays controlled and the body receives support smoothly.
前臂肌群参与控制手腕和手指，配合手掌完成承重与卸载。观察落手、移重和离手时，可留: The forearm muscles help control the wrist and fingers as the palm takes and releases weight. During hand placement, weight shifts, and lift-off, notice palm-heel contact and wrist direction; the image alone cannot explain pain or training tolerance.

In front and side support, observe the space between the rib cage and shoulder and how the shoulder blade moves with the body.
斜方肌中下部和菱形肌参与肩胛位置的调整，与其他肩带肌群协同支撑。观察换手后的肩髋: The middle and lower trapezius and rhomboids help adjust shoulder-blade position and work with other shoulder-girdle muscles to support the body. 胸大肌参与上臂相对躯干的运动，与肩臂肌群共同控制支撑方向。观察前撑转侧撑时，可关: The pectoralis major helps move the upper arm relative to the trunk and works with the shoulder and arm muscles to control support direction. 背阔肌参与上臂与躯干之间的运动控制，与肩带和核心肌群协同工作。观察支撑转移时，可: The latissimus dorsi helps control movement between the upper arm and trunk, working with the shoulder girdle and core.
